scope: Publication and browser inspection of the Hush privacy, early-access terms, security, support and responsible-disclosure routes.
limitations: Verifies published information and community issue/reporting paths only. Does not establish legal compliance, legal review, staffed support, an accountable incident owner or completion of an operational drill.
evidence: The published Hush website presents product availability and limitations, privacy/deletion/revocation instructions, early-access terms, security scope and support/reporting routes. All 20 routes passed the static reference verifier; these five pages were also inspected in the browser.
